diagnostics.message:
Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {d : ℕ}
  {A : Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential d} {𝓕 : Electromagnetism.FreeSpace} (hA : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) A.val)
  (J : Electromagnetism.LorentzCurrentDensity d) (hJ : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) J)
  (h : Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.IsExtrema 𝓕 A J) (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
  Time.deriv (Time.deriv fun x_1 => (Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.electricField 𝓕.c A x_1 x).ofLp i) t =
    𝓕.c.val ^ 2 *
          ∑ j,
            Space.deriv j
              (Space.deriv j fun x => (Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.electricField 𝓕.c A t x).ofLp i) x -
        𝓕.c.val ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * Space.deriv i (fun x => Electromagnetism.LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x -
      𝓕.c.val ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ *
        Time.deriv (fun x_1 => (Electromagnetism.LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J x_1 x).ofLp i) t
